---
name: 功能添加 / Feature request
about: 建议新增或增强一个功能。Suggest a new feature or an enhancement.
title: "[功能 / Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## 描述 / Description
> 你想看到什么功能？用一句话说明。What feature would you like? One sentence.

## 动机 / Motivation
> 为什么需要？解决什么痛点？Why is it needed? What problem does it solve?

## 预期行为 / Expected behavior
> 你期望它如何被调用、返回什么？How should it be invoked and what should it return?

## 验收标准 / Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 示例：新增 `kingdee_xxx` 工具，可在 Mock 和真实账套下调用 / e.g. add a `kingdee_xxx` tool callable in mock and live mode
- [ ] …

## 系统边界 / Scope (Kingdee layer)
- [ ] 数据/服务层（WebAPI，可做） Data/service layer (WebAPI)
- [ ] 平台插件层（C# BOS 插件，超出 WebAPI） Platform-plugin layer (out of WebAPI scope)

## 金蝶版本 / Kingdee version
> 目标账套/版本；接口若有版本差异请注明。Target tenant/version, and note any version-specific endpoint differences.

## 备选方案 / Alternatives
> 你考虑过的其它做法。Any alternatives you considered.

## 附加材料 / Additional context
> 截图、日志、相关链接。Screenshots, logs, links.
